posts.text: Chainalysis confirms an attacker using 'offensive agentic techniques' got into its systems. Customers' user IDs, names, emails and role labels were exposed; no sign of passwords, MFA secrets or investigation data taken. (via CoinGape)
posts.note: The outlet gets the link; the card carries our framing.

posts.text: Hermantown, Minnesota's city council passed all six resolutions for a Google-backed data center late Friday, after about four hours of public comment, mostly from opponents. Google still needs other agencies' permits, and three lawsuits are pending.

posts.text: S&P Global cut Meta's credit outlook to negative, projecting negative free operating cash flow of $71 billion in 2027, mainly from leasing data-center capacity. It kept the AA- rating.
